deterministic.disclaimer: Research output only; not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
deterministic.summary: The three-seed nesting-penalty candidate was rejected. Its mean paired whole-tumor Dice effect was -0.00072 with a 95% case-cluster interval from -0.00196 to +0.00050; two of three seed effects were negative and the frozen guardrails failed. The verified baseline is retained for internal research use.
limitations: Results use 53 repeated observations from one internal BraTS validation split.
The evidence does not establish performance on an independent cohort or clinical fitness.
Baseline seed 20260821 has documented checkpoint-recovery history.
Automatic promotion and autonomous job execution remain disabled.

llm.reason: No LLM rendering is needed; deterministic evidence is complete and remains the source of truth.
